subject: Provisional ingress safeguard for Cerulean-XS (request + product asks)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, OpenWeights <engage@openweights.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: provisional ingress safeguard for Cerulean-XS (new variant)

Alex —

Quick ask from Product: Nexa Health is ready to pilot Cerulean-XS-6B (open checkpoint) in a dedicated staging lane for a targeted clinical summarization workflow. They surfaced two concerns that mean we should consider a provisional ingress safeguard (temporary pin/flag) rather than a full intake right now:

- Tokenizer parity: their dataset uses a custom BPE preprocessing; OpenWeights ran a tokenizer conversion but flagged a ~0.6% tokenization divergence on clinical abbreviations (see tokenizer-diff.txt).
- Regression risk: early evals show a small uptick in hallucination on medication lists at high temperature settings.

Product asks:
1) Can Model Ops provisionally block Cerulean-XS across low-latency tiers until we validate tokenizer parity, or alternatively gate it to a staging-only footprint?
2) What telemetry and eval hooks do you need from Nexa to certify the model for canary?
3) If we require a temporary pin, what is the narrowest scope (routes/tiers/regions) we can apply to minimize customer impact?

I attached the vendor compatibility report (compat_report_Cerulean-XS.pdf) and the tokenizer diff. OpenWeights is looped to provide fixes but asked us to confirm the ingress policy before they push a patch.

Can you take a look and propose a short canary + flag plan by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, OpenWeights <engage@openweights.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional ingress safeguard for Cerulean-XS (new variant)

Thanks Lauren — good summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before Karthik/Dev weigh in:

- When you say "staging-only footprint" do you mean (A) staging project + internal canary users, or (B) staging + single external customer (Nexa) in an isolated routing bucket? For rollout planning that's an important distinction.
- For the tokenizer divergence: do we have a minimal failing prompt example we can include in the canary eval set? That speeds up automated gating.

From an API surface perspective I'm inclined to recommend a narrow provisional pin scoped to: 1) exclude the low-latency (S) tier; 2) allow staging + single-account canary (Nexa) under a dedicated route; 3) enable strict telemetry for the first 72 hours (token-level deltas + hallucination classifier results).

My only hesitation is dependencies on any tokenizer patch from OpenWeights — if they push an updated tokenizer we should verify the new artifact in a quick replay before lifting the pin.

If that approach sounds acceptable I'll ask Karthik for the exact flag mechanics and Dev for the canary telemetry hooks.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Product Lead, Serving Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, OpenWeights <engage@openweights.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional ingress safeguard for Cerulean-XS (new variant)

Lauren / Alex —

We ran a short compatibility sweep on our staging hardware and have a few notes:

- Flag scope: we can implement a route-level feature flag that maps the model to a single customer route (Nexa) and a staging route. That will block access from public low-latency tiers.
- Telemetry: we'll enable token-level mismatch logging + the hallucination classifier (it emits a 0-1 score) for all requests to the canary route. Logs will be sampled at 100% for the first 24 hours then 10% thereafter.
- Rollback surface: implementing the route flag gives us immediate rollback (flip to fallback model) with <30s impact window.
- Tokenizer check: to validate OpenWeights' patch we need a deterministic seed set (5–10 prompts) including the failing clinical abbreviations. We can run a replay job that takes ~45 minutes on staging nodes.

Two operational asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the exact prompts for the replay (we need them as a GDoc or a JSONL).
2) If OpenWeights pushes a new artifact, they must provide a SHA256 and a short changelog so we can validate identical weights and tokenizer mapping before the replay.

If we get prompt examples today we can have the route flag and telemetry live by tomorrow morning and start the canary as early as Tuesday afternoon PST.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, OpenWeights <engage@openweights.ai>, Julie Park <julie@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional ingress safeguard for Cerulean-XS (new variant)

Appreciate the fast turn. Julie — thanks for being flexible on the initial scope. Per Karthik's ask, I uploaded five targeted prompts to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cerulean-XS-ingress-plan (section "tokenizer-replay"). The prompts include the clinical abbreviations that differed in the vendor report.

OpenWeights — please confirm you will produce a patched tokenizer artifact with SHA256 and a one-line changelog once available. If you can deliver by EOD Monday we can start the replay Tuesday and aim for a staged canary on Nexa by Wednesday.

Action summary:
- OpenWeights: push tokenizer patch + SHA256 + changelog (deadline: 2026-11-09 EOD PT)
- Karthik/Dev: implement route-level flag + telemetry (target: 2026-11-10 morning PT)
- Product (Lauren/Alex): approve canary start once replay completes and metrics pass (target: 2026-11-11)

If everyone's aligned I'll file the formal pin request ticket (RI-3421) to document the temporary ingress scope and duration (initial 7-day provisional pin, subject to extension on results).

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
Attachments: compat_report_Cerulean-XS.pdf, tokenizer-diff.txt
